newsitem.title: CHINA: YITAI COAL OPENS UP 9.5 PCT ON DEBUT.
newsitem.headline: YITAI COAL OPENS UP 9.5 PCT ON DEBUT.

text.p: Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Co Ltd's foreign currency B shares debuted on the Shanghai stock exchange on Friday, opening at $0.446, up 9.5 percent on the offer price of $0.4073.
Yitai listed a total of 166 million B shares on Friday. The shares were issued in mid-July.
Brokers said the opening price reflected the value of the company, one of China's biggest coal producers.
"The company is in a key industry which has special government support," said one broker.
"But the industry is also under strict government control," he said. "These factors will ensure the company performs steadily but also that it expands only slowly in the short term."
A second broker said Yitai's opening price was in line with market expectations and was "roughly compatible with the company's near-term prospects".
Brokers said they expected Yitai's B shares to consolidate at around the $0.440 level for the rest of the day.
